_doc: T-292 analyst model settings. Pinned from the live Anthropic /v1/models listing on 2026-07-09 (efficient tier daily / stronger tier weekly, per the director). Model IDs are EXACT strings sent to the API; a drift is caught because provenance records model_id_requested vs model_id_served and validate_note re-checks. Prices are USD per MILLION tokens — best-known published values; the fail-closed $30/mo governor is the real budget guard (actual volume is <$2/mo at these tiers, so a price drift is immaterial to the cap). Reconcile against the billing console if precise accounting is ever needed.

daily_agentic._doc: T-360. The AGENTIC arm's own output cap. It shares the daily tier's MODEL with the constrained arm but not its output budget: the constrained arm emits the note and nothing else, while the agentic arm narrates its tool trace first. Measured 2026-09-15→18, that preamble grew 880 → ~2700 chars and pushed the JSON past the 1500-token cap, truncating the note mid-value on 3 consecutive sessions (coverage 84.4% → 33.3%). This cap is deliberately SEPARATE so the fix cannot touch the CONTROL arm mid-experiment. The monthly $30 fail-closed governor remains the real budget guard; observed cost is ~$0.05/note.

llm._doc: T-331 item 5 — the OPERATOR CONTROL SURFACE, now on a real path. cost_governor.load_governor() reads THIS block and intel_pulse builds its shared governor from it, so these values actually bind the running machine (previously load_governor had ZERO callers and this block did not exist — the documented kill switch was unreachable). Set kill_switch true to stop ALL LLM spend (analyst + agentic + watchdog + event) at the next pulse; steps report skipped:kill_switch and the pulse continues (report-only steps never block trading).
